title: Semi-classical heat kernel asymptotics on complex manifolds with boundary
summary: Let $M$ be a relatively compact open subset of a complex manifold $M'$ with smooth boundary $X$ and let $L$ be a holomorphic line bundle over $M'$. Assuming that condition $Z(q)$ holds, we establish the semi-classical asymptotic behavior of $e^{-\frac{t}{k}\Box^{q}_k}$ near the boundary $X$ as $k\to\infty$, where $\Box^{q}_k$ is the $\bar{\partial}$-Neumann Laplacian acting on $(0,q)$-forms on $M$ with values in $L^k$.
